schema.title: Schema Management
schema.selectToViewDetails: Select a document template from the sidebar to view its details.
schema.requiredExplanation: Require this field to have a value. Documents without this field will be marked as incomplete.
schema.searchableExplanation: Include this field's content in search results. Disable to exclude from search queries.
schema.hiddenExplanation: Hide this field from the user interface. The field will still be stored and accessible via API.
schema.editFieldDescription: Modify the properties of this field. Changes will apply to all documents of this type.
schema.aiExtractableExplanation: When enabled, AI will attempt to extract this field's value from documents. Use the description and extraction hint below to guide the AI extraction process.
schema.denormalizationExplanation: Map this custom field to a standard system variable so it can be used across line items. For example, if you extract a custom 'Billing Date', you can map it to the system's standard 'Date' so it automatically applies to every row.
schema.isPrimaryKeyExplanation: Mark this field as the unique identifier for records. Only one field per collection can be a primary key.
schema.isImportantExplanation: Mark this field as important for quick identification. Important fields are highlighted in the UI.
schema.isDescriptionExplanation: Use this field as the main description for the record. Description fields are used in summaries and previews.
schema.isReconcilableExplanation: Allow this field to be used for matching and reconciliation between documents. Typically used for amounts, dates, or identifiers.
schema.isInstitutionExplanation: Mark this field as representing a financial institution (e.g., bank, credit card company). Used for institution-specific features.
schema.manualExplanation: User edits value manually, e.g., Comments
schema.aiExtractedExplanation: Extracted by AI upon upload, e.g., Total
schema.formulaExplanation: User/AI formula code generation to apply on extracted fields, e.g., sum total
schema.fieldPathHint: Path to the field to aggregate, e.g., 'items.amount'
schema.currencyFieldPathHint: Path to the currency code field, e.g., 'header.currency'
schema.inputFieldsHint: Paths to input fields for the formula (press Enter to add)
schema.codeHint: JavaScript function body that computes the field value
schema.formulaCodePromptPlaceholder: Describe the formula code you want to generate...
schema.datasetsHint: Dataset type names to load for formula execution (press Enter to add)
schema.dryRunTabHint: Run the current formula code on a small sample of this type's documents (dry mode only, no data is saved).
schema.addFieldDescription: Create a new field for this schema section.
schema.technicalNameHint: The technical name used in code and database. Auto-generated from display name.
schema.descriptionPlaceholder: Brief description of what this field contains...
schema.fieldNameExists: A field with this name already exists
schema.deleteFieldConfirmation: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"? This action cannot be undone and may affect existing documents.
